evidence: Explicitly addresses libbitcoinkernel error handling and adds src/kernel/result.h and updates src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp.
rationale: Decoupling fatal error handling from hardcoded AbortNode calls is essential for libbitcoinkernel embedders to recover and inspect errors cleanly at the API boundary. The author explains that 'error handling in libbitcoinkernel application code [is] difficult, because the only way to handle these errors is to register for notification callbacks.'
